title: RFC 6455 protocol ownership
summary: The WebSocket layer owns only WebSocket protocol mechanics above the selected stream: HTTP Upgrade validation, framing, masking, message/control opcodes and close lifecycle.
invariants: Client frames are masked and the mask source is injected.
Text, binary, continuation, ping, pong and close opcode identity is represented explicitly.
Extended payload lengths belong to WebSocketCodec, not to the carrier.
Ping/pong and the close handshake are WebSocket lifecycle, not generic socket lifecycle.
Fragment FIN/opcode identity is represented, but dev1 does not claim complete fragmented multi-frame message reassembly.
permessage-deflate and other WebSocket extensions are not implemented in dev1.
RFC 8441 WebSocket over HTTP/2 and RFC 9220 WebSocket over HTTP/3 are separate future access/carrier compositions; dev1 does not claim either.
